Spotlight

There are untold reasons to be insanely bullish on them, such as:
-TVL 4x’ing in recent months…
-$fxUSD, their flagship stablecoin, absolutely SURGING in market cap this year! 
-$fxUSD being one of the most decentralized and permissionless stablecoins in all of crypto…
-fxSAVE providing some of the best organic stablecoin yield in crypto!
-Morpho-looping of fxSAVE and Pendle-gigabrainery built on it (and the combination of the two!) providing absolutely INSANE yields! (click here [ https://substack.com/redirect/84be25ce-1cdb-466a-838b-e06f735cf203?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] to learn more!)
-Their leverage-trading interface with built-in liquidation protection (see below!)
-@FX100Perp, the new sister protocol to @protocol_fx being built up on the above leverage-trading architecture (but with 100x leverage!), having MASSIVE testnet success (and Mainnet coming soon!)…
-And tons of other bullish stuff too numerous to mention!
Stay tuned for more info coming soon as we continue banging the drum about everything they are doing, read the fantastic thread below, and make sure to follow them on Twitter [ https://substack.com/redirect/7a5c73be-ad15-4be9-9c2a-b6fe9dd132c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] for ongoing updates!
